finding: src/anomaly/workflow_inputs.py:61 The repaired schema-aware input boundary still treats unconsumable source and gate values as complete capabilities.
rationale: The public run_workflow path is reachable at P1, P4, and P7 with these malformed values, because capability detection accepts them before run_attempts invokes stricter downstream validators whose exceptions consume all three attempts, and no upstream guard makes that path unreachable or fail-safe.

evidence.output: normalize_inputs validates only top-level names; source_requests requires source-field presence but does not validate an empty source_id or the included=False reason condition; _is_complete_mapping requires only an outer list/tuple and nonblank identity, without validating sequence elements.

run_workflow derives capabilities from input_capabilities and resolves P1/P4/P7 ready, then run_attempts calls consume_owner with the original supplied values; downstream owner exceptions are caught and retried until MAX_ATTEMPTS, so malformed values consume attempts instead of pausing.

The missing guards exist only after attempt entry: register_local_source rejects an empty source_id and requires reason when included is false; approve_detector_plan rejects non-string detector IDs; accept_findings rejects non-string claim IDs.

The gated reviewer probe reports blank_source_id ['sources'], non_string_gate_id ['gate_a'], non_string_claim_id ['gate_b'], and included=False without reason ['sources'], confirming each malformed payload is advertised as a capability.
